title: Meter Reading, Estimated Bills and Field Access Under the Metering Service
content:
**Reading.** Remotely read **Metering Service** meters are read on every billing period end date. Manually read meters are field-read at the meter type's field-read interval in months and estimated under the type's estimate method in between, unless a customer reading is accepted. A customer reading is used only where the meter type accepts customer readings and the reading is submitted within the type's customer-read window, in calendar days, before the billing period end.

**Estimate limit.** The number of consecutive estimates is the count of the installation's most recent readings, up to the handling date and taken most recent first, that are estimated. When that count reaches the meter type's estimate limit, the next reading must be an actual field read made within the type's field-read period in business days.

**Access failures.** A failed field visit is recorded as an access failure. After the meter type's access-failure threshold of consecutive failures, an access letter is sent and a customer reading is requested.

**One reading per period.** Each billing period end date has one reading per installation; a period end date that already carries a reading for the installation receives no second reading.

**True-up.** Estimated usage is reconciled under the meter type's true-up rule, which posts the difference on the service agreement as a backbill for an estimated-read true-up or as a billing error correction credit.

## Condition and result

| Condition | Result |
|---|---|
| Remote read method | Read on every billing period end date |
| Manual read method, month between field reads | Estimated, unless an accepted customer reading exists |
| Customer reading submitted inside the window, type accepts customer reads | Used for billing |
| Consecutive estimates reach the estimate limit | Next reading is an actual field read within the type's period |
| Consecutive failed visits reach the access-failure threshold | Access letter sent and a customer reading requested |

## Hypothetical illustrations

- An estimate limit of 2: the installation's last two readings are estimated and the one before is actual. The count of consecutive estimates is 2, so the next reading must be an actual field read.
- A customer-read window of 3 days and a billing period ending on the 30th: a customer reading submitted on the 27th, 28th, 29th or 30th is inside the window; one submitted on the 26th is not.
